'''''The Foundation Creed''''' was a set of guiding principles for [[House Salaktori]], a chapter of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], which was adhered to by members of the chapter around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
